# NDA generator: draft one-way or mutual non-disclosure agreements (template, not legal advice)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' NDA drafting guide: it walks you through the situation (context, parties, what needs protection, one-way or mutual), generates a complete agreement (definitions, confidentiality obligations, standard exclusions, duration and termination, return/destruction of materials, remedies, governing law, signature blocks), and lets you customize duration, protected categories and jurisdiction. Key clauses are explained with when-to-use guidance — definition of confidential information with standard exclusions, three standards of care (reasonable / same-as-own / highest), the two timeframes (agreement term vs confidentiality period), and remedies (injunctive relief, damages, attorney's fees). Templates by situation: investor meetings (usually one-way, 2 years, noting many investors won't sign NDAs), contractor/employee, partnership discussions (mutual), technical collaboration (mutual, 3–5 years, residual knowledge cautions). Jurisdiction notes for the US, EU, China and UK, six common mistakes to avoid, and the skill's own explicit limits. Honest caveats: **this is a template, not legal advice** — the skill itself says it cannot provide legal advice, cannot guarantee enforceability in your jurisdiction, and cannot replace attorney review for high-stakes situations; its MCP section references an `office-mcp` server (`create_docx`, `fill_docx_template`, `docx_to_pdf`) that likely does not exist in your setup, so expect plain text/docx work...
